title: News Gapper
teaches: The News Gapper as we trade it: a fresh named catalyst, most often an earnings report, gaps a liquid stock up on at least three times its average volume; the gap holds and the day closes green in the upper half; the buy is the first pullback and reclaim, a market order as price trades over the prior day's high after two down days or an inside day that hold the gap-day low, or day one over the opening-range high for an A+; the stop sits a few cents under the pullback low, the first sell is a judgment, usually day 3 or later into a 3, 5 or 7 day push, with the rest on the 10-day or 21-day trail, and a loss taken at the stop is the system working.

walkthroughs.title: ULTA, March 2016: a big gap and a shallow pullback
steps: ULTA, 2016. Report on 2016-03-10; the gap day is 2016-03-11, up 14.2% on 4.8x volume. It closes at 94% of its range.
A big gap out of a correction. Then a 4-session pullback, 2.8% deep, that holds the gap-day low.
Day 6: buy at market over the prior day's high, 190.69. Stop a few cents under the pullback low, 186.55.
Failure mode: a close under the gap-day low. Instead it ran to 12.1R. Sell into a push, trail the rest.

walkthroughs.title: TWLO, February 2018: a gap through the 200-day
steps: TWLO, 2018. Report on 2018-02-13; the gap day is 2018-02-14, up 10.0% on 8.3x volume. It closes at 62% of its range.
It gaps out of a 3-month bottom, through the 200-day. Then a 6-session pullback holds the gap-day low.
Day 8: buy at market over the prior day's high, 33.55. Stop a few cents under the pullback low, 32.59, 2.9% away.
